content.short: Zyfi is a Paymaster-as-a-Service provider on ZKsync enabling gasless and ERC-20 gas payments.
content.description: Zyfi is a specialized infrastructure provider on the ZKsync ecosystem that leverages Account Abstraction (AA) to revolutionize the user experience. As a 'Paymaster-as-a-Service,' Zyfi enables decentralized applications to offer gasless transactions or allow users to pay gas fees using any supported ERC-20 token instead of the network's native ETH. This significantly lowers the barrier to entry for new users and provides a seamless, flexible transaction experience for the entire community. Zyfi simplifies the complexities of gas management, making blockchain interactions more intuitive and accessible.
content.meta: Zyfi provides Paymaster services on ZKsync for gasless and flexible ERC-20 gas payments. Discover Zyfi and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
